artifacts.summary: Compares four candidate definitions of the ℚ-time predicate IsQTime and recommends intrinsic divisible + pairwise-commensurable (no new imports). isDense_of_isQTime, the ℚ instance and ValidQTime ↔ ValidDense are verified sorry-free in a scratch snippet; strong set-based completeness over ℚ-time is not free and is left open.
